newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still a buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers and its local associate Banco Patrimonio said they have reiterated their buy rating on Brazilian federal telecoms giant Telebras.
-- The investment banks said in a report that they are reissuing their recommendation because Telebras stock is trading at a low price compared with the Latin American average for telecoms stocks.
-- "We reiterate our buy rating on Telebras because it is trading at the low end of the Latin American average both on FV/EBITDA AND FV/access line," the report said.
-- It also said "Brazil represents great telephony growth potential including an evolving regulatory environment."
-- The report also cited the government's April 3 announcement of a "new aggressive tariff structure" for the sector which exceeded expectations.
-- "Under the new structure, Brazilian telephony will be more in line with the rest of Latin American telephony," the report said.
-- The banks said they were raising their 1997 earnings estimate for Telebras' American Depositary Receipt (ADR) to 3.789 billion reais or $10.85 per ADR from 3.557 million reais or $10.17 per ADR.
-- They also raised their 1998 estimate to 4.865 billion reais or $13.30 per ADR from 4.769 billion reais or $13.05 per ADR, the report said.
